name: Morning Sunlight
description: Step outside and bask in the morning light.
implementation_intention: After I open the curtains I will step outside for a few minutes of morning sun.
environment_prompt: Comfortable slippers and a shawl left by the back door.
reward_description: A calm warm start that lifts the mood for the whole day.

name: Savour a Small Pleasure
description: Pause to enjoy a small pleasure — perhaps a warm cup of tea by the window.
implementation_intention: When my morning sunlight is done I will sit quietly and enjoy one small pleasure slowly.
environment_prompt: A favourite cup or chair set out by the window.
reward_description: A small daily pleasure to savour without rushing.
temptation_bundle: Watch the birds in the garden while I rest.

name: Gentle Stretch
description: A few minutes of gentle stretching to keep the joints fluid.
implementation_intention: After my morning tea I will do five gentle stretches in my chair.
environment_prompt: Soft cushion placed on the chair as a reminder.
reward_description: Looser easier movement throughout the day.

name: Tend the Garden
description: Spend time gardening — watering planting or simply tidying.
implementation_intention: When the morning cools I will put on my gloves and tend to the garden.
environment_prompt: Watering can and gloves left by the patio door.
reward_description: The quiet joy of nurturing something growing.
temptation_bundle: Listen to the radio or birdsong while I potter.

name: Gentle Movement
description: A gentle movement practice I enjoy — Tai Chi yoga or simple stretches.
implementation_intention: When my morning programme finishes I will do a gentle movement practice I enjoy.
environment_prompt: Open space cleared in the living room with my video or mat ready.
reward_description: A fluid unhurried body and a settled mind.

name: Mindful Lunch
description: Eat slowly and stop at 80 percent full — hara hachi bu.
implementation_intention: When I sit down to lunch I will eat slowly and pause before I feel full.
environment_prompt: Smaller plate set out and the table laid calmly.
reward_description: Easy digestion and a light comfortable afternoon.

name: Afternoon Walk
description: A slow gentle walk around the neighbourhood or park.
implementation_intention: After lunch has settled I will put on my coat and walk at an easy pace.
environment_prompt: Walking shoes and coat ready by the front door.
reward_description: Fresh air gentle movement and a clearer head.
temptation_bundle: Notice one new thing in nature each walk.

name: Call a Friend
description: Connect with a close friend or family member — keep the moai strong.
implementation_intention: When I sit down with my afternoon tea I will phone someone dear to me.
environment_prompt: Phone and address book kept on the side table.
reward_description: Laughter warmth and the comfort of close company.
temptation_bundle: Save the call for a friend who makes me smile.

name: Creative Craft
description: Time for a beloved craft — knitting drawing or music.
implementation_intention: After my afternoon rest I will sit down with my craft for a little while.
environment_prompt: Craft basket left open and ready in the favourite chair.
reward_description: The deep satisfaction of making and contributing.
temptation_bundle: Only work on a project I truly enjoy.

name: Gratitude Note
description: Write down one small thing to be thankful for.
implementation_intention: After the evening meal I will write one good thing from today in my notebook.
environment_prompt: Notebook and pen kept on the bedside table.
reward_description: A peaceful unhurried close to the day.

name: Evening Wind Down
description: Gentle reading or quiet music before bed.
implementation_intention: When I am ready for bed I will read a few pages by the soft lamp.
environment_prompt: Book and reading lamp set beside the bed.
reward_description: A restful slow descent into sleep.
